name: execute_code
description:
Run a Python script in the sandbox with python3. Use when a task needs logic, loops or data processing that would otherwise take several terminal calls, or to compute something exactly. Print your final result to stdout.

Each call is a fresh process: variables and imports do not survive between calls, so write intermediate data to files when you need it later. Scripts run in the session's working directory. Limits: 5-minute timeout. Stdout over 50KB shows head/tail inline; the FULL text is auto-saved to a file whose path rides in the result.

code.description: Python code to execute. Print your final result to stdout.
